sourceRefs.locator: Gregory IX.42; Epistolae 914, first paragraphs and final appeal: Chlothar’s resources, Agnes’s election, obedience of the founder, protection of property, and burial in the church dedicated to Mary even if unfinished.
Carmina XI.19, Latin text, translation, recipient and historical context: milk and other delicacies, a doctor’s orders and the closing greeting.

summary.de: In ihrem Brief schildert Radegunde die Wahl von Agnes zur Äbtissin. Fortunatus schrieb ihr Gedichte über die kleinen Geschenke, die sie ihm schickte.
summary.en: Radegund’s letter describes Agnes’s election as abbess. Fortunatus wrote to her in verse about the gifts she sent him.
